observation: The versioned Python 3.10 asyncio task documentation says a wait_for timeout cancels the task and raises asyncio.TimeoutError, showing that the older spelling is scope-dependent rather than a contradiction of the Python 3.12 rule.
title: Coroutines and Tasks — Python 3.10.20 documentation
worker_claim_observations: The asyncio.wait_for section says a timeout raises asyncio.TimeoutError and shows except asyncio.TimeoutError in its example.
